items.name: East London Mosque
items.description: One of the largest mosques in the UK, accommodating over 7,000 worshippers. Open to visitors and tourists. Jumu'ah prayer every Friday.

items.name: London Central Mosque
items.description: The iconic golden-domed mosque near Regent's Park. One of London's most recognisable Islamic landmarks, welcoming over 5,000 worshippers.

items.name: Brick Lane Halal Restaurants
items.description: Brick Lane is London's curry capital with dozens of halal Bangladeshi and Indian restaurants. Most are fully halal certified — look for the certificate displayed.

items.name: Edgware Road — Arab Quarter
items.description: London's Middle Eastern hub with authentic Lebanese, Egyptian and Syrian halal restaurants, shisha cafes and Arabic supermarkets.

items.name: Wembley Central Mosque
items.description: Convenient mosque for visitors to Wembley area. Regular prayer times and Friday Jumu'ah. Wudu facilities available.

items.name: Heathrow Airport Prayer Rooms
items.description: Multi-faith prayer rooms in all Heathrow terminals. Qibla direction marked, prayer mats and wudu facilities available 24/7.

items.name: London Central Mosque
items.description: One of London's largest and most iconic mosques, with a striking golden dome. Welcomes visitors and hosts daily prayers, Friday Jummah, and community events.

items.name: East London Mosque
items.description: One of the largest mosques in Europe, capacity for thousands. A hub of the Muslim community in East London with regular events and classes.

items.name: Brick Lane Jamme Masjid
items.description: Historic building with a fascinating past — once a church and synagogue before becoming a mosque. A symbol of London's multicultural history.

items.name: Maedah Grill
items.description: Popular halal Middle Eastern grill known for generous portions of grilled meats, rice and fresh salads at affordable prices.

items.name: Tayyabs
items.description: Legendary Punjabi halal restaurant famous for its sizzling lamb chops. Always busy, always worth the wait — a London institution since 1972.

items.name: Green Street Halal Food Quarter
items.description: A whole street dedicated to halal South Asian food, sweets and grocery shopping. Vibrant atmosphere and incredible variety.

items.name: Regent's Park Mosque Prayer Hall
items.description: Large, welcoming prayer hall accommodating thousands, with separate facilities for women. Ablution facilities available.

items.name: Westfield Stratford Prayer Room
items.description: Dedicated multi-faith prayer room inside Westfield Stratford City shopping centre, convenient while shopping.

items.name: Heathrow Airport Prayer Rooms
items.description: Multi-faith prayer rooms available in all terminals at Heathrow, clearly signposted and open 24 hours for travellers.
